253:t_1:81.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's the spirit, $$勝平$$! $$ノノ$$ will do her best too!」

253:t_1:83.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'll do it too! If we keep fighting, I'm sure we'll get to see $$グーラ$$ again!」

253:t_1:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yeah! Yeah! $$ノノ$$ cheers on the friendship between $$正太郎$$ and $$グーラ$$ too!」

253:t_1:86.en:
$$チコ$$
「Come on, Princess. At a time like this you've got to get fired up along with everybody.」

253:t_1:88.en:
$$チコ$$
「Maybe that girl's effort and guts got to me.」

253:t_1:89.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do our best together too, $$ラルク$$. With effort and guts!」

253:t_1:90.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Effort and guts aside, I'll do the fighting to get back to Earth.」

253:t_1:91.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Earth is an important place for me too, after all.」

253:t_1:93.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Yeah, yeah, enough of the stifling heat.」

253:t_1:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Let's set our hearts aflame and do our best!」

253:t_1:100.en:
$n
(I'll live through this no matter what... And then, I'll go back to Earth.)

253:t_1:101.en:
$n
(We have enemies we have to fight to protect that planet...)

253:t_10:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Well... let's get this started quickly. I've got $n waiting for me after this.」

253:t_10:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「Don't worry. I'll end it quickly.」

253:t_10:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's a funny joke, coming from you! Bring it on, $$隼人$$!」

253:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Um... is it all right, Mr. $$弁慶$$? To just leave them be...」

253:t_10:9.en:
$$弁慶$$
「It's their way of saying hello after meeting again. They'll stop once they get bored.」

253:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「True, the mood isn't as hostile as their words, after all.」

253:t_10:11.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We respect each other's strength in our own way. Otherwise we couldn't run a team.」

253:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're quite right. In the earlier battle, when Mr. $$竜馬$$, Mr. $$隼人$$ and Mr. $$弁慶$$ each shot down an enemy...」

253:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z was produced. I'll add it to the unit's stock.」

253:t_10:14.en:
$$弁慶$$
「...Well, I've gotten tired of just watching. I'll get in some exercise myself so the artificial gravity doesn't make me go soft.」

253:t_10:15.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$甲児$$, $n, $$シモン$$, $$ヴィラル$$! It's no fun just watching, is it, you guys!」

253:t_10:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Well, yeah, not after being shown a battle like that up close.」

253:t_10:17.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$隼人$$ is my prey. I can't let $$竜馬$$ be the one to take him on.」

253:t_10:18.en:
$n
「Then, since we have that promise, I'll take on $$竜馬$$.」

253:t_10:19.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then let's go! Let's have plenty of fun!」

253:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Good! Very good! I can't wait to see how many $$Ｚチップ$$ these men's fiery battle will produce!」

253:t_10:21.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Out of the way, $$ＡＧ$$! Move it!!」

253:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I am so glad you made it back safely!」

253:t_10:29.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, I heard it from everyone. That you used the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to search for us, $$ＡＧ$$.」

253:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$, being a crystal of $$Ｚチップ$$, reacts to people's feelings and wishes, after all.」

253:t_10:31.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then it picked up on our wish to get back to everyone, didn't it.」

253:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, it also picked up all sorts of other feelings overflowing from the $$ジェニオン$$, let me tell you.」

253:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s private lesson with the stars of the galaxy as the backdrop...」

253:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oops... you're no longer a 'teacher,' are you.」

253:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I was, loud and clear.」

253:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You... look like you want to die, huh?」

253:t_10:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Never mind. Crushing you would be a real hassle afterward.」

253:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make me angry, $$ＡＧ$$. If you do, you know what happens, don't you?」

253:t_10:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good kid. Keep yourself in check from now on.」

253:t_10:46.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...No... as you were a moment ago, there's no need to call you 'Miss.'」

253:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never thought the plan I had nearly given up on would get a second wind at this point... This is thanks to $n too.)

253:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'm going to give it my all too! Even at the center of the galaxy... business, business!」

254:t_002:4.en:
$n
「It's just so funny that I couldn't hold it in.」

254:t_002:5.en:
$n
「We got thrown to who knows where, and we still end up coming face to face with those guys again...!」

254:t_003:0.en:
$n
「It looks like they have no intention of letting us get away! Let's go, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

254:t_003:2.en:
$n
「There must be a unit controlling these things!」

254:t_003:3.en:
$n
「Depending on the situation, we'll hit them and secure a base for our actions from here on!」

254:t_003:4.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What do I do... Even in a situation like this... my heart won't stop pounding...)

254:t_003:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
(...I've decided, $n... No matter what happens, I'll follow you...)

254:t_003:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Even if the end of the world is closing in, I believe in the strength you're aiming for.)
